svg.title: Request latency by model, JevBench and JF100
svg.desc: Box plots of per-request latency in milliseconds on one RTX 3090, log scale, for v19, b1, b2, e1a and e1b. JevBench v19 median 64 ms; JevBench b1 median 73 ms; JevBench b2 median 97 ms; JevBench e1a median 35 ms; JevBench e1b median 36 ms; JF100 v19 median 60 ms; JF100 b1 median 71 ms; JF100 b2 median 92 ms; JF100 e1a median 30 ms; JF100 e1b median 31 ms
svg.text: Per request, served with --compile, one RTX 3090 under WSL2, log scale, both panels on one scale.
Box: quartiles · line: median · whiskers: 1.5 × IQR · dots: beyond.
JevBench· 230 tasks over HTTP, first request dropped

svg.text: T5Gemma 2: encoder-decoder from Gemma 3. T5Gemma 2B: the encoder of T5Gemma 2B-it UL2 (Gemma 2), decoder dropped.
e1b is hobson-bidi's reference. Numbers beside boxes are medians, in ms. Hover a box for its five-number summary.
